featured_reviews.name: Vaibhav Tapase
featured_reviews.review_text:
An Unforgettable Experience at Monalisa Lawns!

We recently celebrated my brothers Wedding at the Monalisa Lawns, and I cannot recommend this venue highly enough! From the moment we first visited, we were impressed by the beautifully maintained space, the lush greenery, and the overall peaceful yet grand ambiance.

The team at Monalisa was incredibly professional, attentive, and supportive throughout the planning process. They were always available to address our questions, offered great suggestions, and ensured every detail was perfect on the big day. Special shoutout to the event coordinator who went above and beyond to make sure everything ran smoothly!

The lawn itself is spacious, ideal for both large gatherings and intimate ceremonies. The lighting setup in the evening made the entire space glow with a magical charm, and our photos turned out stunning thanks to the beautiful natural backdrop.

Parking was ample and convenient, and our guests kept complimenting us on the choice of venue. Whether it’s décor flexibility, vendor coordination, or just the vibe — Monalisa Lawns exceeded all expectations.

If you’re looking for an elegant, open-air venue that feels both grand and personal, Monalisa Lawns is the one. Thank you for making our special day absolutely perfect!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Pankaj is the man for you to capture and treasure your beautiful moments of time. We had the cherishable company of Pankaj and his team at our wedding and they are incredible very professional yet very personal and emotive. They captured all the moments with complete poise and style keeping us at very ease and comfort.

The photos tell the story of our love and compassion and bring back to us every emotion and feeling from our wedding day and we look at them with joy, laughter and tears. Pankaj is truly talented and amazing. We will treasure these memories for forever. Thank you so much!!!

featured_reviews.name: Sylvester Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am deeply disappointed with the services provided by Pankaj Rokade. I booked him to cover my relatives' 25th Anniversary on December 29, 2023, and the experience was nothing short of frustrating.

From the beginning, I had to constantly follow up with him for about 4-5 months as he rarely responded to my messages or answered my calls. This lack of communication was extremely stressful and unprofessional.

Despite the persistent follow-ups, I finally received the photos and videos in May, several months after the event. The quality of the video was subpar and seemed rushed, likely because I had to continually remind him. When I requested changes to the video, he assured me he would make them, but now, nearly seven months since the event, and he has once again started ignoring my calls and messages. I still have not received the final content.

It feels like he might deliver the 25th anniversary videos by the time my relatives' 26th anniversary rolls around. This level of service is unacceptable, and I have never encountered such unprofessional behavior from a service provider.

I strongly advise against booking Pankaj Rokade for any event, as you will likely face significant hassles and potential financial loss. I would not recommend his services to anyone.

featured_reviews.name: natasha chopra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was eight months pregnant last year when I got in touch with Anupa for my shoot. I stay in Ahmedabad so Anupa had to travel here for a day from Bombay.
It was monsoon time and of course the rain played truant with our outdoor shoot plans.
However Anupa was a rockstar and a brilliant photographer. She worked with the rain and shot the most beautiful pictures of me with my bump. She was aware of my tiredness and the time crunch - we only had a day- and managed to get all the shots I wanted and some more ! We had an indoor shoot after and my space had a lot of lighting constraints for her. Yet she thought on her feet and delivered the loveliest pictures of me. The best part is her creative use of any space she shoots in. She uses it thoroughly to her advantage and comes up with brilliant shots. Absolute genius!
It’s been 8 months since we shot together and I find myself often looking back on the pictures she took. I look radiant happy and to my eyes beautiful. I credit this solely to Anupa. She didn’t get frazzled with the rain, with my exhaustion, with the time crunch or space constraints. She worked with everything like a pro and delivered the best to me. Additionally she has the kindest attitude and coolest temperament. I am not fond of shoots and I am also camera shy. But with gentle and intelligent coaxing she got me to emote and actually enjoy myself during the shoot.
After a long time in the pregnancy I felt good and a bit like myself. I recommend Anupa blindly to anyone looking for a photographer to not only capture them at their best but to make them feel beautiful about themselves.
I am waiting for her to do my baby shoot next!

featured_reviews.name: Archeeta Pujari
featured_reviews.review_text: Anupa was my wedding photographer. From the very beginning, she was a delight to work with, responsive to text messages and taking a personal approach. One of the big pluses is that she is an honest business owner and doesn’t ask for payment in cash to evade taxes (unlike the others I contacted)! Her fees are very reasonable for the time and quality of service she provides. She took a lot of interest in getting to know us and our style and likes and dislikes (including asking us to fill out a great questionnaire!). On the day she was a fun and friendly presence and many of the guests enjoyed interacting with her. She and her colleagues were complete professionals, and took some fantastic shots. It is clear from the end product that she absolutely tailored her style to take my preferences and requests into account - she did not deliver a one size fits all. The album was delivered on time and is of exceptional quality. Thanks for capturing the lovely memories ! I could not recommend more.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much Archeeta! From the very start, I loved your clarity in how you saw your wedding being captured and asking all the right questions to be sure we are all on the same page. Made the entire process so seamless and pleasurable. So glad we got to be a part of such an intimate and beautiful wedding! Thank you for choosing us <3

featured_reviews.review_text: Supriya did an outstanding job capturing my sister's engagement moments at the Westin Hotel Pune. The photos are not just pictures; they tell a beautiful story of love and joy. Their attention to detail and creative angles added a unique touch to every shot. The entire experience was smooth and her ability to make us feel at ease helped into relaxed and natural expressions with final photographs exceeding our expectations. She also has some great ideas and unique poses for photo shoots. She not only captured in detail pictures from bride side, but equally for groom's side as well. My brother in law's family were also very delighted. Highly recommend Supriya Shah's photography for anyone looking for a talented and professional photographer.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Chaitralee, 

Thank you so much for your heartfelt and generous review! It was an absolute pleasure capturing those special moments at Pune, and I'm thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the experience.!!

featured_reviews.name: Vanitha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: It was an absolute  pleasure to having been captured by u... In our photographs obviously. Right from my pregnancy in 2017 to my daughters 1st birthday in 2018 and till date when she's 6 years... You have captured our moments so beautifully that we love to go back to them so often. Plus the patience u have to handle the mood swings of the pregnant lady and the rebellious 1 year old.. Hats off to you.. U took care of us so well and thats the second reason we come to u to get our first reason (capturing memories) fulfilled.. Love you supriya for being our go to photographer.. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Vanitha,

I am truly touched by your heartfelt words! It has been an incredible journey capturing the beautiful moments of your family from the joy of pregnancy to your daughter's 6th year. Your kind words mean the world to me, and I'm thrilled to hear that the photographs bring back cherished memories.
